text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe's dream isn't
to win the Japanese Derby. Even so――
The temptation of a once-in-a-lifetime dream was overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Trainer-san,
with this lap time...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The Derby... I might actually have a shot.
If I can win... surely my "friend" will also...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I can't say I'm in peak condition...
but that's just how it always is...
Whether to run in the Derby or not... is, honestly, a tough call to make.

"Even so, as long as both sides hold onto hope,
there is a chance. Choosing your path
can wait a little longer."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"One more chase, please.
This time, push me harder than before..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Cease this at once.
A brisk, clear voice cut right through the instructions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Dreaming unscientific dreams is all well and good, but finding
out it was unscientific only after it shatters is pure foolishness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not telling you not to enter the Japan Derby.
Just keep your late push moderate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Cafe, as you are right now, you lack the foundation to withstand rigorous training.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san...
What has happened... to you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...I certainly do. I quit being a horse girl (Umamusume)
and became a horse-around girl."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do every day is research you.
From morning until the next morning, it's one grand way to kill time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Still, thanks to this, one thing has become clear. What takes priority right now is not overworking this emaciated body, but recovery. Restoring mass.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If you truly insist on hard training,
then go ahead and test yourself.
—Three sets on the uphill slope, starting now."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Once you make it up 1 and 4/7ths of the hill,
that'll be your finish line.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

The result was—just as predicted.
Having run a lap and a half, Manhattan Cafe's legs ground to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: See? Well, it was bound to turn out like this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A boring, foregone conclusion that anyone could guess
even without clairvoyance. Truly in poor taste.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To be frank, this was also a test. If you were mistaken, the Trainer's bet would have been justified after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This proves it.
There's no need to force a Derby win.
No need to chase a conventional dream.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"We're a team of oddballs anyway.
We were crazy from the start, so let's stop pretending to be normal."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She's been crazy from the start...
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Not nearly as much... as you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh, hahahaha! Indeed!
Look at you, perking up a bit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You agree with me, don't you, Cafe, Trainer?
That we shouldn't rush right now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not telling you to completely change your mind.
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's simply that observable facts were placed onto the scales.
Right, Trainer?
Prompted to make a decision... I look at Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I... suppose you're right... The idea of loosening up a bit is... well...

As long as Manhattan Cafe
is convinced...
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll think it over carefully.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fufu, a wise decision. Well, I'm sure you already understood, and I knew that you understood as well.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer...
For a while... at a modest pace...

With Agnes Tachyon joining the team, the precision of our key decisions has improved.
This will surely give us a boost going into autumn.
